servers.name: Databricks MCP Server

servers.description: Provides Claude with full access to Apple Calendar on macOS for event management, smart scheduling, and schedule analytics. It enables natural language event creation, conflict detection, and template-based scheduling through AppleScript integration.
servers.name: Apple Calendar MCP Server

servers.description: Provides machine learning researchers with tools for creating publication-quality scientific visualizations, statistical plots, and 2D data representations. It streamlines the research workflow by enabling AI assistants to generate complex figures from CSV, JSON, or direct data inputs.
servers.name: ML Research MCP

servers.description: Enables users to create and interact with hand-drawn sketches and architecture diagrams directly within chat interfaces using Excalidraw. It leverages the Model Context Protocol to provide interactive HTML visualizations with smooth viewport control and fullscreen editing capabilities.
servers.name: Excalidraw MCP App Server

servers.description: An Obsidian planning server that integrates GTD and PARA methodologies to manage daily notes, tasks, and project workflows. It features 17 tools for organizing vaults, including inbox prioritization, weekly review generation, and full-text search capabilities.
servers.name: mcp-obsidian-planner

servers.description: Provides access to IMDB movie and person data, including searches, cast details, and top-rated lists through the Model Context Protocol. It enables LLMs to fetch structured cinematic metadata and filmographies using the Cinemagoer backend.
servers.name: IMDB MCP Server

servers.description: An MCP server that connects LLMs to CERN GitLab to discover and analyze High Energy Physics code, documentation, and analysis examples. It provides 14 tools for repository browsing, dependency parsing, and CI/CD configuration analysis.

CERNGITLAB_TOKEN.description: Personal access token (optional). Create a token with `read_api` scope at https://gitlab.cern.ch/-/user_settings/personal_access_tokens for access to internal/private projects, code search, and wiki pages.

servers.name: CERN GitLab MCP Server

servers.description: Connects AI agents to the Rippling HR/IT/Finance platform to query employees, manage leave requests, and view organizational structures. It provides eighteen tools for accessing company data, employee details, and administrative activities through the Rippling API.

RIPPLING_BASE_URL.description: API base URL. For sandbox/testing, set to https://sandbox.rippling.com/api/platform/api.

servers.name: Rippling MCP Server

servers.description: Enables real-time web search with source citations by leveraging Perplexity AI's Sonar models through SAP AI Core. It integrates with Claude Code to provide deep analysis, reasoning, and up-to-date information from the web.
servers.name: Perplexity Search MCP Server

servers.description: Enables automated cryptocurrency trading on Binance and provides integration for monitoring Base network operations. It allows users to execute trades, fetch market data, and calculate technical indicators like RSI and MACD through the Model Context Protocol.
servers.name: Binance MCP Server

servers.description: BridgeContext is a productivity tool designed to capture and transfer conversational context between different AI platforms (like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini) to improve workflow continuity.
servers.name: Bridgecontext

servers.description: MCP server for Zig that connects AI coding assistants to ZLS (Zig Language Server) via LSP. Provides 16 tools for code intelligence (hover, go-to-definition, references, completions, diagnostics, rename, format) and build/test operations.

zls-path.description: Path to ZLS binary (default: auto-detect from PATH). Corresponds to the --zls-path flag.

workspace.description: Project root directory (default: current working directory). Corresponds to the --workspace or -w flag.

servers.name: zig-mcp

servers.description: Enables AI assistants to interact with Odoo data using natural language to search, read, create, and update records. It acts as a secure bridge between MCP clients and Odoo instances version 17.0 through 19.0.

ODOO_YOLO.description: YOLO mode - bypasses MCP security (⚠️ DEV ONLY). Values: off, read, true

servers.name: MCP Odoo Bridge Server

servers.description: An MCP server that enables users to query, compare, and synthesize responses from multiple local and cloud LLMs simultaneously using existing subscriptions. It provides tools for parallel model evaluation, consensus polling with an LLM-as-judge, and response synthesis across different model providers.

OLLAMA_URL.description: The URL for the Ollama backend (e.g., http://localhost:11434). Can be skipped if not using this backend.

CLIPROXYAPI_KEY.description: The local API key/passphrase for CLIProxyAPI, which must match the key defined in its config.yaml.

CLIPROXYAPI_URL.description: The URL for the CLIProxyAPI backend (e.g., http://localhost:8317). Can be skipped if not using this backend.

servers.name: HydraMCP

servers.description: Bridges Claude Code and other MCP clients to RemNote, enabling users to manage their knowledge base through natural language. It supports creating, searching, and updating notes, as well as appending content to daily journals via a dedicated bridge plugin.

REMNOTE_WS_PORT.description: The WebSocket port used to communicate with the RemNote MCP Bridge plugin. (Default: 3002)

servers.name: RemNote MCP Server

servers.description: Provides AI-powered child safety tools to detect bullying, grooming, and unsafe content within digital conversations. It enables AI assistants to perform emotional analysis and generate age-appropriate safety action plans or incident reports.

SAFENEST_API_KEY.description: Your SafeNest API key, obtained from safenest.app

servers.name: SafeNest MCP Server

servers.description: Enables remote command execution and file management over SSH and SFTP, supporting persistent connection storage and automated discovery for BinaryLane VPS servers.

SSH_CONNECTIONS.description: Legacy environment variable for defining SSH connections via a JSON string array of connection objects.

BINARYLANE_API_TOKEN.description: Optional API token for auto-discovery of active BinaryLane VPS servers.

servers.name: SSH MCP Server

servers.description: An MCP server that enables AI agents and LLMs to interact with the Test MCP Server Feb6 USDT API through standardized tools. It provides features such as Docker support and async operations for efficient integration.

STAGE.description: Environment stage (default: MAINNET, options: MAINNET, TESTNET)

servers.name: Test MCP Server Feb6 USDT
